India Accuses Pakistan of Terror Doublespeak at UN

India has accused Pakistan of "terror doublespeak" at the United Nations, stating that the world has not forgotten the attacks of 9/11, 26/11, and the Pahalgam incident. This statement was made by India's representatives at the UN.
